# Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker

An alternative Umbraco Media Picker that surfaces recently uploaded media first, plus a "Recent" layout
in the Media section itself. Generated from Umbraco's own `umbraco-package`/`umbraco-extension` dotnet
templates (a single RCL project - `src/Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker` - with an embedded `Client/`,
not a hand-rolled Core/Client split), following the Crumpled Dog package conventions (Central Package
Management, semantic-release versioning, git-flow-per-Umbraco-major branching, package-validate-before-
publish CI).

## Repo shape

```
src/Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker/            the packable RCL - controllers, composer, Client/
src/Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker.TestSite/   dev/CI fixture site (not packable, not shipped)
tests/Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker.Tests/    NUnit + Moq + Umbraco.Cms.Tests
Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker.slnx            solution file, repo root
Directory.Packages.props / Directory.Build.props    Central Package Management + UmbracoTargetMajor
```

## Rules an agent must follow here

- **Formatting**: `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is a hard CI gate. Run `dotnet format` before
  proposing any C# change is done.
- **Versioning**: never hand-edit a version number anywhere (`.csproj`, `package.json`, tags). Version
  comes solely from semantic-release reading Conventional Commit messages; the `.csproj` only ever
  references `$(PackageVersion)`.
- **Commit messages**: Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.) - see
  `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` for the full type-to-bump mapping.
- **Branching**: this repo only targets Umbraco 17 today (`develop/v1`/`release/v1`/`beta/v1`). Don't
  invent `v2` branches or files unless the user is actually adding Umbraco 18 support.
- **OpenAPI client codegen**: `Client/src/api/**` is generated by `npm run generate-client` (from
  `src/Umbraco.Community.RecentMediaPicker/Client/`) against the TestSite's own Swagger doc
  (`/umbraco/swagger/recentmediapicker/swagger.json`). It's gitignored - never hand-edit it, and always
  use the generated SDK functions rather than raw `fetch()` calls from new frontend code.
- **uSync + alias renames**: renaming a manifest alias or `EditorUIAlias` does not retroactively update
  Data Types already imported into a database - see the Anti-patterns section of `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`
  for the fix-up procedure.
- **User-level Start Node permissions ARE honored** (via `ContentPermissions.HasPathAccess`, unconditionally,
  on every request) - don't confuse this with the Data Type-level "Start node"/"Ignore User Start Nodes"
  config fields, which are deliberately NOT honored. See the root `README.md`'s Configuration section
  before "fixing" either as a bug.
